output.content: The shadow deployment environment is currently broken, so we cannot route live traffic to a candidate model for comparison. The pipeline that was supposed to mirror production data to the shadow instance stopped working after the last infrastructure update, and the logs show the connection failing immediately. Because that setup is not functioning, the team is manually exporting a sample of recent production inputs and running the candidate model against that static dataset in a separate notebook. This manual step is the only way to check if a new version behaves correctly before we consider promoting it. The shadow infrastructure itself is still provisioned, but it is not receiving any data.
output.reclassify_reason: The text reports the current operational status of the shadow deployment environment and the resulting manual workaround without expressing any wishes, trade-offs, or explicit needs.
